conclusion: No already established small semantics-preserving patch resolves the performance HOLD. Stop further design expansion in this review.
observed_facts: JSON already serialized once per call; moving it out of inner loop is not a new fix.
Read pool enforces query_only=ON; a TEMP-table population would cross current read-only boundary.
A MATERIALIZED CTE inside each batch remains statement-local, not call-global.

Consolidating into one SQL statement could reduce repeat membership for multiple batches, but changes batching/error-observation and has not been implemented/reviewed. It also cannot by itself remove the adverse one-statement dense and sparse cases.
